image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a rocky substrate. The organism displays an elongated oval shape with a distinct dorsal armor consisting of eight overlapping calcareous plates embedded in a textured, leathery girdle. The plates show mottled brown, grey, and reddish coloration with visible growth lines. The surrounding environment includes encrusting algae and small marine organisms on the rock surface.
